feature: Announcements UI 5: the Announced group on /decks/precons. R1b-2's unboxed `new` mark on the group head, set block and set row; posted early lists as precon tiles (rows in the rows view) with "early list" in --fact; the early seen key `early:<code>:<count>` (handoff design_handoff_the99_announcements: Announced, R1b-New-Mark)
note: Run on a SCRATCH branch (no new migration), with ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED on for the account (flag_overrides, scope user) except in `switch-off`. Needs an upcoming Commander set with revealed commanders (Star Trek Commander, TRC) and a Commander decklists post resolving to it: the scratch fixture is the Star Trek decklists post with 3 of 5 lists, each list's commander_card_id set to a TRC legend and its cards matched by name. Each row names its `phase`, set before that phase and again before each width (one width per run), because every visit writes seen keys. The runner does not read `phase`; run the phases one at a time with a filtered copy of this file. Phases: `unseen` = upcoming_seen_codes empty, the post at 3 lists; `unseen-rows` = the same, apart because the tiles cell's visit acknowledges the lists; `seen` = upcoming_seen_codes holding exactly what an `unseen` visit wrote (`early:trc:3`, read back after that phase), photographed on a fresh load (a second visit in one browser restores the first's scroll and loses the head); `relit` = the same keys and a fourth list posted (Kirk); `switch-off` = `unseen` with ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED off for the account (allow the 30-second override memo to pass). Widths 390 and 1300, drawn tall (2400 and 1600) so the Announced group is in frame.
